rows.en: Seravee! You head to the Terminal Unit! Leave this one to us!!
Seravee! Hurry to the Terminal Unit! We'll take care of this one!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll handle this one!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll handle this one!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll handle this one!
Seravee! You go to the Terminal Unit! We'll handle this one!
Seravee, please go on to the Terminal Unit! We'll handle this one!
Seravee! You get your butt to the Terminal Unit! We've got this one covered!!
Got it! While I'm accessing Veda... I'm sorry, but... please hold out!!
You people... are the evil that throws the world into chaos!! If only you were all goooone!!
Gah... Regnant!! What are you talking about...!?
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ngh... What on earth is this enemy talking about!?
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Whoa...!! ...What is this thing talking about!!
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ngh... What's this thing goin' on about!?
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ugh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ugh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ugh... What is this thing talking about!!
Ngh... What is this thing talking about!!
Gah... What is this thing talking about!!
What the hell...!? What's this thing yappin' about!?
You're the ones who started this fight!! You're the ones who twisted the wooorld!!
...Not bad!! This one's a seriously tough customer...
Owww!! That freakin' hurts!! ...Hey, you!! You're pretty damn strong, huh!!
What the hell is with this thing...
Hmph... Just as I thought, they're nothing special.
Well? How do you like Regnant's power?
So, do you understand the power of the Innovators now?
So it was you after all...!!
I see. So it was you after all...!!
You jerks again...!! You're one persistent bunch of bastards!!
So Regnant's one of these 'Innovator' things too?
That's right. Regnant was granted that power by Reborns's own hand.

notes.note: Leader-variant blocks follow this script's Pt_Chara_Check chain 10,6,9,8,7,1,2,4,5,11,12,13,15,14,3 (00, Nu, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Rider 1, RX, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Zero, Mebius, Den-O). IDs 6=Nu / 7=Zeta confirmed by Pt_Chara_Check(6)/(7) guarding 0.120/0.121 in the next slice; the rest inferred from wording (polite 'san' = Mebius at pos 13, rough = Momotaros at pos 14, casual = W at pos 7). Blocks: 0.29-0.43 (starts in story_116), 0.47-0.61, 0.63-0.77, 0.80-0.94, 0.100-0.114. This row = W.
OOO (polite 'hikiukemasu'). 'We'll take care of this one' = 'I/we' subject restored.
Momotaros. 'koitsu' for Regnant rendered 'this one'/'this thing' throughout: Regnant's glossary gender is n, so no he/she.
Seravee (Tieria) asks the leaders to hold out while he accesses Veda; 'taete kure' = please endure/hold out.
Regnant repeats its line from 0.27 (story_116); addressed to the Lost Heroes. Stretched ending mirrors the drawn-out 'naku nareba-aaa'; cut sentence kept as an unfinished conditional.
Regnant: subject 'You' restored (the heroes, whom Regnant blames for starting the war and warping the world). Japanese is two 'it was also [you] who...' fragments.
'osareteiru' = being pushed back; 'chikara-make shiteiru' (0.64, 0.72-0.74) = losing on strength -> 'I'm being overpowered'. Subject 'I' restored in all of these.
Momotaros reacting to the hit, then grudgingly praising Regnant's strength.
'dou suru' rendered 'What do we do!?' (leader speaking for the party). Ultraman/Seven/Taro variants.
Speaker '???' laughing alongside Regnant; likely Reborns Gundam (who appeared as ??? in story_116 0.4). Kept as plain laughter.
Gaddess (Hiling): 'omoi shitta?' = 'now do you understand / has it sunk in'. 'Innovator(s)' matches earlier slices.

'mata omae-tachi ka' (rows 0.101, 0.103-0.113) = 'It's you again'; leaders recognise the Innovades from earlier fights. 0.100 (00) and 0.102 (Wing Zero) use 'kisama' and 'yahari' -> 'So it was you after all'.
'Reborns' = Reborns Gundam (Ribbons), name form used in earlier slices. Name 'Regnant' repeated instead of a pronoun (glossary g = n).

report: 80/80 rows. Five leader-variant blocks ordered by Pt_Chara_Check chain (10,6,9,8,7,1,2,4,5,11,12,13,15,14,3); identical Japanese given identical English. Uncertain: 0.96 '???' laugh assumed Reborns Gundam; Gundam IDs 8/9/10 (God/Wing Zero/00) inferred from wording. 'Innovator', 'Terminal Unit', 'Reborns' follow earlier slices (not in glossary).
